Name: (Outdated) Bonster's Crops and Recipes Retexture
Description:
[b]Note Nov 2023: [/b][color=#ea9999]I am not planning to keep this mod maintained or update it. I love drawing crops, and would rather spend my time making new crops rather than drawing sprites for someone else's crops :) However, I am keeping this mod up in case anyone wants to repurpose the assets or edit it for personal use. I hope you all can understand this decision <3[/color]

This retextures [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61875811]rjgilber's[/url]﻿ mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3438]Bonster's Crops[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3468]Bonster's Recipes[/url]﻿. I have gotten permission from rjgilber to upload these assets.

Install instructions:
- Download Bonster's Crops and Bonster's Recipes (Recipes is optional, but recommended)
- Download this mod and open the .rar
- Drag all three folders inside to your Mods folder (or two folders if you don't have Recipes)
- Choose "Replace all files".

This only replaces image files, so your game is safe. If you want the original assets back, simply reinstall the original mods' files.
